# EvoMesh v0.1.0-alpha.1

This is the first public pre-release of EvoMesh: a local-first environment where persistent agents can collaborate, use skills, run on different local models, and evolve through reviewable candidate generations.

## Highlights

- Windows Forms Control Center for starting/stopping the mesh, chatting, issuing commands, creating agents, assigning models, and editing settings.
- Separate Ollama or OpenAI-compatible provider/model configuration for every agent.
- SQLite-backed identities, BDI-shaped state, messages, permissions, and evolution history.
- Agent Architect interview flow and isolated candidate validation.
- One-click Windows launchers plus the original interactive console.

## Windows quick start

1. Download `EvoMesh-v0.1.0-alpha.1-win-x64.zip` and its `.sha256` file.
2. Verify the archive checksum, then extract it to a writable directory.
3. Install [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and optionally [Ollama](https://ollama.com/).
4. Double-click `start-evomesh.bat` for the Control Center, or `start-evomesh-console.bat` for the console.

The first launch creates a local Python environment and may download Python packages. EvoMesh can start without Ollama, but agent inference requires the configured local provider and model.

## Experimental status

Permissions are enforced by EvoMesh and are not a hardened OS sandbox. Candidate promotion is intentionally human-controlled. Review generated changes, grant the smallest necessary filesystem access, and do not expose local endpoints to untrusted networks.

See `CHANGELOG.md` and the repository README for the full feature and limitation list.
